item.title: Enabling Nvidia Power Management means I can say Goodbye, Windows 10
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
Nvidia's driver on NixOS wasn't broken, but my usage of it was (well, maybe it was broken a little bit).

Now that it's working, I can say "bye Windows".
